text:
Marta: Heads-up — planning to push kernel/quant bundle r7 -> r8 tonight in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Breaking ABI for the matmul kernel but runtime shim should handle it.
Raj: Thanks. Is the rollout going to be canaryed? I want a small steady slice first.
Marta: Yes — /deploy engine:quant-kernel@r8 --canary=2% --stages=2 --window=02:00-04:00 UTC. Will pin cross-region images for the first 3 hours.
Deploybot: Preflight checks started for engine:quant-kernel@r8
Deploybot: Preflight: build artifacts OK, signature verified, packaging checksum OK
Elie: Quant build ran on staging, perf looks fine at seq512, ~7% CPU perf improvement. Notice slightly higher thermal headroom on A100 nodes during long-run tests.
Mike (QA): In canary smoke we saw 2 OOM logs over 30m on a single host; logs attached: ``[ERROR] kv_cache_alloc failed: out of memory``. Not on all nodes.
Zara: Flagging that — if OOMs appear on >1 host or >0.5% of requests we rollback automatically. Set the threshold in deploybot.
Marta: Agreed. Rollback criteria: error_rate_increase >= 1.5% for 15m OR OOM_count >= 3 hosts in 30m OR median latency p95 worsens >20ms. Also, pin TTL 03:00 UTC (pin until 05:30 to allow post-cutover observation).
Raj: Can we add a thermal/pack-level check? If node GPU temp > 85C sustained for 10m, circuit-break to fallback kernel variant (engine:quant-kernel@r7-compat).
Deploybot: Canary slice created: 2% traffic -> region us-west-2, shard set A. Telemetry links: https://telemetry/internal/r8-canary/1718923456
Marta: I'll add release notes snippet: "engine: quant kernel r8 — matmul ABI upgrade, optimized attention kernels, ~7% CPU throughput improvement at seq512; fallback variant available." Who wants to own the release-note entry?
Elie: I'll own the release notes and add links to perf graphs + flamegraphs.
Mike (QA): I'll run an extended 2h soak on canary shard and post symptoms. I'll also run stress memory allocations with kv-cache toggled off to replicate OOMs.
Zara: Oncall will monitor infra dashboards. If deploybot triggers rollback, Ops will preemptively drain affected nodes.
Oncall Bot: Pager schedule: Zara oncall 02:00-06:00 UTC; escalation -> Raj -> Marta.
Marta: Quick safety checklist before /deploy: 1) docs updated, 2) fallback image available, 3) rollback playbook pinned, 4) canary dashboards linked. All good?
Raj: Docs and fallback image ready. I pushed fallback tags to artifact repo.
Elie: Perf graphs linked in the telemetry page.
Marta: Ok kicking off in 10. Command I'm running: ```/deploy engine:quant-kernel@r8 --canary=2% --stages=2 --pin-ttl=3h30m --safety-thresholds "err>1.5%|oom_hosts>3|p95>20ms|gpu_temp>85C"```
Deploybot: Deploy started by Marta at 1718923720. Stage 1 -> canary 2%. Preflight again passed.
Mike (QA): Seeing canary warmups now. No new OOMs in first 12m. CPU temps +3C but within limits.
Zara: Monitoring. If we see OOMs or error spikes, I'll hit /deploybot rollback and start node drains.
Marta: If everything stays green for 30m, we'll advance to stage 2 and widen to 20%. If stage 2 passes 45m, we'll do full-cutover with a staggered regional rollout.
Elie: Reminder: after full rollout run the quant-retrain sanity eval against the canonical prompt set. I'm on it.
Mike (QA): I'll post a short post-deploy note in #incidents if anything flares.
Zara: Copy. Good luck :rocket:
